name: island
title: Island
description: Where you are and how things stand, in one graphite capsule at the top of a place: a status LED, the place's name, one quiet fact and a chevron. It opens the place's menu; a passing event turns into the fact's place on the swap drum and the capsule follows it, then turns back.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/island.md. SwiftUI: not yet (planned: MetalIsland).
